description: This file defines an Android RecyclerView.Adapter called ReceiptsListAdapter, which manages and displays a list of Receipt objects. It also includes an inner ViewHolder class JobsHolder to hold references to the view components for each receipt item.

classes.name: ReceiptsListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for a RecyclerView displaying a list of receipts, managing view creation, data binding, and item count.

classes.name: JobsHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class for receipt list items; manages references to item views and handles item click events.

methods.name: ReceiptsListAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a list of Receipt objects.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new JobsHolder by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds Receipt data to the views for a given position in the list.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of receipt items.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes string inputs by replacing 'null' strings or null references with an empty string.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on individual receipt items (currently empty).
